key_results: Quantum Fisher information increases strongly without characteristic scale as strange metal forms; indicates high multipartite entanglement; provides positive descriptor of strange metallicity; observed in heavy-fermion compounds via inelastic neutron scattering
comments: The quantum Fisher information approach provides a novel thermodynamic signature, though the mechanistic link to superconductivity and other properties remains speculative.

model_io.model: Heavy-fermion compound near quantum critical point (Kondo destruction)
Quantum Monte Carlo simulations
Inelastic neutron scattering experiment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantum criticality in strange metals correlates with high multipartite entanglement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; quantum Fisher information diverges without characteristic scale

title: Evidence of time-reversal symmetry breaking above the charge density wave order in a kagome metal
task: Evidence for time-reversal symmetry breaking above charge density wave order in kagome metal CsV3Sb5
key_results: Time-reversal symmetry breaking occurs well above CDW transition temperature; dichroic photoemission signals indicate loop-current order; complex temperature evolution shows intertwining of loop-current and CDW orders; hierarchy: loop-current → CDW → superconductivity
comments: Momentum-resolved circular dichroism provides elegant evidence, though direct confirmation of loop-current order microscopic phase requires complementary probes.

model_io.model: Kagome metal CsV3Sb5 crystal

hypotheses.hypothesis: Time-reversal symmetry breaking occurs at same temperature as CDW order
hypotheses.result: Refuted; TRS breaking occurs above CDW transition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Loop-current order underlies TRS breaking and CDW
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dichroic response indicates loop-current; complex temperature evolution shows intertwining

title: Orbital Hall conductivity and relaxation in thin films with variable disorder
task: Characterizing orbital Hall effect and relaxation dynamics across disorder regimes in Mn thin films
key_results: Orbital Hall conductivity scales linearly with electrical conductivity in hopping-dominated regime (amorphous to polycrystalline); orbital relaxation time ~picoseconds; disorder-dependent crossover from on-site dephasing to interorbital hopping; crystalline order features Elliott–Yafet scattering
comments: The scaling behavior analogous to anomalous/spin Hall effects suggests orbital angular momentum is a robust degree of freedom, though the picosecond relaxation times may limit device applications.

model_io.model: Mn thin films with variable disorder (amorphous to α-Mn single crystal)
Orbital Hanle magnetoresistance measurement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbital Hall conductivity scales with electrical conductivity regardless of disorder
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; linear scaling in hopping-dominated regime

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relaxation mechanism transitions with increasing crystalline order
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; crossover from on-site dephasing to interorbital hopping to Elliott–Yafet scattering

title: Strong coupling of a microwave photon to an electron on helium
task: Demonstrating strong coupling between microwave photon and quantized electron motion on superfluid helium
key_results: First demonstration of strong coupling regime with single electron on helium; cavity-enhanced photon-electron interaction enables coherent quantum exchange; provides basis for single-electron spin qubit readout protocols
comments: Achievement of strong coupling is significant for quantum computing platforms, though scalability to multiple qubits and decoherence mechanisms require further investigation.

model_io.model: Electron bound to superfluid helium surface in superconducting resonator cavity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong coupling regime is achievable between photon and electron-on-helium motional state
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong coupling demonstrated

title: Optimized N-deque partition dual-deque merge string sorting algorithm
task: Optimizing parallel string sorting algorithm via N-deque partitioning and dual-deque merging
key_results: Speedups of 5.25× (Apple M2, 8-core) and 11.92× (Intel Xeon Gold 6142, 16-core); parallel efficiencies 0.65 (20M strings) and 0.74 (50M strings); N-deque structure and OpenMP scheduling significantly impact performance via cache misses and branch mispredictions
comments: The parallel efficiency is reasonable but not exceptional, suggesting memory bandwidth remains a bottleneck even with optimized deque strategy.

model_io.model: Parallel N-Deque Partition Dual-Deque Merge string sorting algorithm

hypotheses.hypothesis: N-deque partitioning reduces cache misses compared to traditional parallel sorting
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; speedups and efficiencies demonstrate improved memory hierarchy utilization

title: Ultra-wideband reflective polarization rotator achieving 104% measured bandwidth with high-efficiency multi-state polarization control
task: Designing ultra-wideband reflective polarization rotator with broadband multi-state control
key_results: 12.68–38.79 GHz coverage (104% measured bandwidth); 91%+ polarization conversion efficiency; peak reflectance >80% over 60 THz; stable operation to 30° oblique incidence
comments: The octa-circular geometry with Omega-type bianisotropy is novel and the measured bandwidth exceeds theory, suggesting potential for further optimization.

model_io.model: Semi-octa-circular copper metasurface on F4BM substrate with ground plane
GSTC analysis and CST full-wave simulations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Omega-type bianisotropy from rectangular cutout extends operational bandwidth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RBW extended to 104% measured

title: Directional motion of a self-steering active intruder in a dense crowd of cognitive active agents
task: Modeling directional motion of self-steering active intruder in dense crowd of cognitive agents
key_results: Intruder steering to avoid agents paradoxically reduces directional speed; agent hyperuniformity (class III) enhanced by collision-avoidance and facilitates intruder navigation; speed and transverse diffusivity determined by maneuverability, vision angle, density
comments: The counterintuitive finding that steering reduces speed contrasts with intuition and has implications for crowd dynamics modeling, though the 2D overdamped model may not capture 3D human behavior.

model_io.model: Overdamped Langevin dynamics simulation with intelligent active Brownian particles (iABPs)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intruder steering increases directional motion efficiency
hypotheses.result: Refuted; steering reduces directional speed; passive positioning more efficient

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent collision-avoidance enhances hyperuniformity and intruder navigation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hyperuniformity facilitates directional motion

title: Investigating the impact of irradiation on various ringFET-based SRAM circuits using 3D TCAD
task: Assessing radiation tolerance of ringFET-based SRAM architectures using 3D TCAD simulations
key_results: BOX-LDD ringFET SRAM with inner-drain design exhibits highest critical dose tolerance; inner-drain arrangement outperforms outer-drain by significant margin; improved radiation robustness vs. junctionless and conventional LDD designs
comments: The study systematically compares architectures but lacks real hardware validation; TCAD predictions need experimental confirmation in actual radiation environments.

model_io.model: 6T SRAM cells based on ringFET variants (junctionless, LDD, BOX-LDD)

hypotheses.hypothesis: BOX-LDD ringFET architecture provides superior radiation tolerance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; highest critical dose tolerance among architectures tested

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inner-drain arrangement provides higher SEU tolerance than outer-drain
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for all device types

title: Study on wind resistance performance of high-rise corridor building based on quasi-steady static aeroelastic analysis method
task: Evaluating wind-resistant performance of high-rise connected corridor buildings using aeroelastic analysis
key_results: Airfoil-section design and connected corridor geometry significantly reduce inter-story displacement and torsion angle; streamlined sections outperform square and elliptical control geometries
comments: The semi-decoupled CFD approach is computationally efficient but approximates fluid-structure coupling; full coupling validation would strengthen conclusions.

model_io.model: High-rise corridor building with streamlined airfoil section
Coupled CFD-FEA aeroelastic analysis (semi-decoupled static)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Airfoil profiles reduce wind-induced deformations vs. square sections
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic reduction in displacement and torsion metrics

title: Numerical investigation and assessment of the Langmuir–Hinshelwood–Hougen–Watson model for dry reforming of methane
task: Assessing predictive validity of literature-derived Langmuir–Hinshelwood–Hougen–Watson kinetic model for dry methane reforming
key_results: Model replicates conversion trends at high and moderate-to-high conversion; systematic deviations at low temperatures; high activation energies indicate composite CH4 activation rather than single step; identifies applicable operating regime
comments: The diagnostic reanalysis without re-fitting is methodologically valuable, but the low-temperature deviations limit model applicability across industrially relevant temperature ranges.

model_io.model: Plug-flow reactor (PFR) with literature LHHW kinetic model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Literature LHHW model accurately predicts conversion across temperature range
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; accurate at moderate-to-high T and conversion, but systematic deviations at low T

title: Path-dependent dynamic response in nano graphite membrane resonators under elastic boundary modulation
task: Understanding path-dependent nonlinear dynamics in 2D graphite membrane resonators with elastic boundaries
key_results: Resonance behavior exhibits frequency hysteresis and bifurcations dependent on sweep direction and speed; higher-order modes show geometry-dependent nonlinearities determined by modal strain-boundary alignment
comments: The identification of boundary elasticity as a hidden degree of freedom is conceptually valuable, though the practical implications for device design remain underdeveloped.

model_io.model: nano graphite membrane resonator with van der Waals interfaces

hypotheses.hypothesis: Elastic boundary dynamics govern nonlinear response independent of driving amplitude
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; path-dependence observed in frequency sweeps

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher-order modes exhibit geometry-dependent nonlinearities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; nonlinearity correlates with modal strain and boundary orientation alignment

title: Waveguide-integrated colour centres in silicon carbide with broadband photonic crystal reflectors for efficient readout
task: Integrating color centers in silicon carbide waveguides with broadband photonic crystal reflectors for efficient readout
key_results: Broadband reflection 60 THz with peak reflectance >80%; saturation intensity 103.8 kcps at low temperature; charge-resonance scheme achieves ~125 kcps; single-shot optical readout fidelity >98% achievable
comments: The Dinosaur photonic crystal design shows promise, but spectral stability at high excitation powers and temperature-dependent performance require improvement before practical quantum information applications.

model_io.model: 4H-SiC waveguide with integrated color center and Dinosaur photonic crystal reflector
Tapered-waveguide-tapered-fiber collection interface

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photonic crystal reflectors enhance color-center photon collection and enable high count rates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 125 kcps achievable with optimized protocols
